title: Dad Pencil's Funny Farm Lesson!
description: Oz takes the family to a farm to teach Sem a lesson about patience... and immediately loses a chicken 🐔 #ThePenFamily #Shorts
thumbnail_prompt: Oz (blue pen, panicking) chasing a cartoon chicken while Sem watches laughing. Bright farm/park background. The whole family in background looking shocked. No text.

beats.text: Son, today you learn patience. At a FARM.
What's a farm?
Wait — why is this a lesson about patience?
Farming takes TIME, son. Years!
I'm gonna go pet dat chicken!
Wait — Sem! Don't chase the —
And the chicken is loose. Recording.
This is FINE. I am very calm.
You are literally running in circles.
Dad — doesn't chasing a chicken require patience?
That's... actually a good point.
Chicken go fast! Like me!
Bawk!
Mira just did a chicken sound. That's a first.
Sem. Just... stand still. Let it come to you.
Okay. I'm waiting. I'm bein patient.
Good. That's... that's patience right there.
It came! I did it!
The chicken taught you patience. Not your dad.
That was my plan the whole time.
